body.ms: Dalam Mak Yong, tarian pembuka Menghadap Rebab memberi penghormatan kepada pemuzik sebelum cerita bermula. Datang awal — sepuluh minit itu sering kali paling menyentuh sepanjang malam.
body.en: In Mak Yong, the opening dance Menghadap Rebab greets the musicians before the story begins. Arrive early — it is often the most quietly powerful ten minutes of the night.
